_comment: Lowercase substrings that indicate the model has stopped acting and is asking the operator for a new target/objective (it considers the current step finished). Used ONLY in the text-only watchdog ABORT path to end gracefully instead of emitting an alarming 'stuck/recovery failed' error. Because it is gated on the abort path (model already failed to act repeatedly), false-positive risk is low. Edit to tune phrasing without code changes.
